newsitem.title: USA: Ralph Lauren could pull in $397 mln from IPO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ralph Lauren could pull in $397 mln from IPO - WSJ.

text.p: Ralph Lauren and his family could pull in a windfall of as much as $397 million if his Polo Ralph Lauren Corp. follows through with its planned initial public offering, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the estimate is based on a price of $23.50 per share. That pricing would put a total value of about $700 million on the offering.

In Securities and Exchange Commission filings, the fashion house said it plans to issue 29.5 million Class A common shares priced at between $22 and $25 per share. Six million of those shares would be offered abroad, while the rest would be sold in the United States.
